verdicts.reason: Both are the same mechanical scale-down of the original into a tall canvas. Each leaves about 100px of empty space at the top and about 90px at the bottom, keeps the small headline and the tiny letter-spaced info line (which still runs nearly to the right edge), and does not rearrange anything for the story format. A is marginally better because it leaves a little more space between the info line and the halftone image. In B the image almost touches the info line, which makes that part feel cramped.
